Poison ailment emitted from 'hit by a poison skill' delivery language (source mechanism → ailment token per §B5-ELEMENT callout); element_primary null (no store damage-type descriptor of form 'deals X damage' for a specific family — 'poison skill' is a skill-category label, not a damage-family descriptor). Companion double-dip scaling (Bloodscent x4 → x16 effective) is source-unique; approximation notes player-cast loop survives but the double-dip economy is engine-gapped. GX-04 corpus flag consistent with mana-stacking economy shape. Filing two-tier-accumulator accrual WITHOUT numbers (mana pool size = scaling substrate).
